messages:
Incident Bot: ALERT: GreenRock (enterprise, dedicated pool: greenrock-eu1) crossing p99 latency threshold (p99=3.9s, p95=1.1s). Impact: sustained for ~6m. Pager: @Jason P
Jason P: Paging in, oncall here — looking at pool metrics now
Maria G: seeing same in dashboards, spikes line up with tenant=greenrock-42 requests
Leo H: pool metrics -> greenrock-eu1 GPU util 98%, queued reqs rising, KV cache hit rate down ~15%
Anya S: reached out to GreenRock CS lead, they report intermittent timeouts on /v1/generate path
Jason P: mitigation plan: tenant isolation + traffic shift to eu2 fallback. Maria, can you enumerate heavy tenants?
Maria G: running check: ```/opt/redwood/bin/poolctl --pool greenrock-eu1 --list-tenants``` returns: greenrock-42 (spiky, 68% of requests), partner-9 (steady)
Maria G: issuing soft-evict for greenrock-42 to allow routing to fallback: ```/opt/redwood/bin/poolctl evict --pool greenrock-eu1 --tenant greenrock-42 --mode soft``` (monitoring)
Ops Bot: Eviction job queued (job id=2637). Notifying pool hosts gr-eu1-1..3
Leo H: toggling routing policy to allow region fallback for greenrock-42: ```curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/routing -d '{"tenant":"greenrock-42","fallback":"eu2","percent":100}'``` — expect ~20s to propagate
Jason P: logs show long KV fetch lat from s3-proxy around same window, correlates with p99 spikes
Maria G: KV proxy 504s increased, restarting kv-proxy on gr-eu1-1..3 now (rolling)
Anya S: GreenRock confirms some successful requests on eu2 after shift (~30s ago)
Leo H: eu2 p99 down to 1.2s, greenrock-eu1 p99 still ~3.5s but volume dropping. Good sign, keep monitoring
Jason P: maintain isolation, prepare for full eviction if p99 doesn't drop under 1s in 15m. Maria, coordinate customer comms
Maria G: sent note to GreenRock: "We've isolated your tenant in eu1 and shifted traffic to eu2; we're monitoring. We'll update when p99 stabilizes."
Prod Liaison: SR-8674 opened for tracking + postmortem. Initial action items: root-cause kv-proxy degradation, capacity check, improve automated fallback thresholds
Jason P: handing oncall to Leo for 30m while I follow up with CS async. Leo, you're oncall. :thumbsup:
Leo H: taking oncall. Running through incident playbook and will update channel every 10m or on meaningful changes
Incident Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=partial_mitigation; p99 trending down. Continue ops in this thread.
Jason P: ack. Notes added to incident doc: https://redwood/internal/incidents/7991234567
Anya S: customer response: appreciative, will want postmortem and ETA on permanent fix
Maria G: attaching logs/graphs to ticket, will include kv-proxy error traces and poolctl outputs
Leo H: next steps: if p99 >1s after 15m -> full eviction + scale warm spare; else let fallback remain and patch kv-proxy then test
Jason P: +1
Ops Bot: paging loop closed for current oncall. :white_check_mark:
